Whole Steamed Fish

Served at: Lunar New Year (Chunjie)

Serves 4-6Prep 15 minCook 15-20 min

Whole steamed fish is a traditional dish served during Lunar New Year (Chunjie) celebrations, symbolizing abundance, prosperity, and a good beginning and end to the year. The word for fish in Chinese sounds like 'surplus,' making it a meaningful dish to ensure wealth and success in the coming year.

Ingredients

  • 1 whole fresh fish (about 2-3 pounds / 900-1350 g), such as sea bass or tilapia, cleaned and scaled
  • 2 tablespoons soy sauce
  • 1 tablespoon Shaoxing wine (or dry sherry)
  • 1 tablespoon vegetable oil
  • 2 teaspoons grated fresh ginger
  • 3 cloves garlic, thinly sliced
  • 3 green onions, cut into 2-inch (5 cm) lengths
  • Fresh cilantro leaves for garnish
  • 1 red chili, thinly sliced (optional)

Method

  1. Rinse the fish and pat dry with paper towels. Make 2-3 diagonal cuts on each side of the fish to help it cook evenly.
  2. Place the fish on a heatproof plate that fits inside your steamer.
  3. Scatter half of the ginger, garlic, and green onions over and inside the fish.
  4. Bring water to a boil in a steamer or large pot with a steaming rack. Place the plate with the fish inside the steamer, cover, and steam for 15-20 minutes, until the fish is cooked through and flakes easily with a fork.
  5. While the fish is steaming, combine soy sauce and Shaoxing wine in a small bowl.
  6. Heat the vegetable oil in a small pan until hot but not smoking.
  7. Carefully remove the steamed fish from the steamer. Pour the soy sauce mixture over the fish.
  8. Drizzle the hot oil over the fish to sizzle the aromatics and release their fragrance.
  9. Garnish with the remaining ginger, green onions, cilantro, and optional red chili slices before serving.

Tips

  • Choose a fresh fish with bright eyes and firm flesh for the best flavor and texture.
  • Serve the fish whole to honor the tradition of completeness and unity during Lunar New Year.
  • You can substitute Shaoxing wine with dry sherry or omit it if unavailable, but it adds authentic flavor.
